about: the site's plates, built by scripts/texture/build.py plates through the vendored fields.py. a size, path or rope width given as a name is read from tokens/details.json plate_inputs; a number is this spec's own. composite plates print the master's indexed image per mode (the overlap keeps its true overprint colour); masks plates print a first and a spot plate per mode, inked by css. master maps each output file to the master plates it must equal, by pixels (same form) or by planes (index & 1 and index >> 1 of a composite against the master's two masks)

opener.width_from: build_sketch.py build(): opener_png(opener, W, H, mode, HOUSE, SKETCH_PATH, 58)
